negative_policy: One separate all-mode 21-block source-only follow-up per profile when any initial immediate-baseline interval is wholly below 1. Retain all initial and follow-up outcomes; no pooling or recursive retries.
strict_win: semantic agreement, confidence lower > 1 and every block faster
scope: Fixed exposed development inputs on one host. All records retained; mismatching Open Babel lanes unranked.
intended_improvement: Native V3000 parse/roundtrip via an inline visited BFS queue (32 atoms) with hashed overflow; preserve exact depth/membership and all existing E/Z behavior
baseline_scope: All thirteen accepted source candidates; all rejected trials excluded
baseline_reuse: Exact accepted source13 native executable; all 10060 current baseline source/input hashes and binary identity verified before editing; no timing reuse
adoption: Exact complete source snapshots, rewrite bytes and diagnostic parity required. Adopt only a meaningful intended gain; reject if clear reproduced new regressions outweigh it. Strict lane requires CI lower>1 and all21.
checkpoint_policy: Checkpoint/artifact writes use an external ENOSPC retry wrapper, releasing an owned 16MiB reserve and retaining computed reports in memory. Native timers, semantic observers, rotating order and source benchmark functions are unchanged. Driver source retained.
